part.text:
Fixed. The grammar in src/parser.y:622 required every `elif` chain to terminate with `else Exp end` — there was no way to end an `elif` chain with just `end`.

Changes:
- Added an `"end"` alternative to `ElseBody` that produces `gen_noop()` (identity, equivalent to `else . end`)
- Removed the now-redundant `"if" Exp "then" Exp "end"` production (covered by `ElseBody: "end"`)
- Regenerated `src/parser.c`/`src/parser.h` with bison 3.8.2 (same version as before) and rebuilt

Verified:
- `jq -n '1,2,3 | if . == 1 then 1 elif . == 2 then 2 end'` → `1 2 3` (plus multi-elif, no-elif, and explicit-else variants)
- Full `make check` passes: 7/7 tests, including the previously failing cases
